findings.subject: entity-iga-cells
findings.text: Patient-derived immortalized IgA1-secreting cells produced IgA1 with galactose-deficient O-glycans.
findings.studySystem: EBV-immortalized IgA1-producing cells derived from human peripheral blood
limitations: Immortalized cultures; does not identify the dominant in-vivo source or establish sufficiency for disease.

findings.subject: entity-il6
findings.text: IL-6 accentuated IgA1 galactose deficiency in IgA1-secreting cultures, with a stronger response in patient-derived cells.
findings.quote: IL-6 and IL-4 accentuated galactose deficiency
limitations: Culture glycosylation response; does not establish clinical benefit from IL-6 inhibition.

findings.subject: entity-gd-iga1
findings.text: Galactose-deficient IgA1 formed immune complexes with patient-derived glycan-specific IgG in vitro.
findings.studySystem: Immortalized human IgG-secreting cells and biochemical binding assays
limitations: Formation requires the matching antibody; this edge alone does not establish renal injury.

findings.subject: entity-antiglycan-igg
findings.text: Patient-derived glycan-specific IgG bound galactose-deficient IgA1 and formed complexes in vitro.
findings.studySystem: Immortalized human IgG-secreting cells and biochemical binding assays
limitations: Antibody specificity and assay context matter; serum associations are not proof of clinical causation.

findings.subject: entity-iga-complexes
findings.text: Large IgA1-containing serum-complex fractions stimulated proliferation of cultured mesangial cells.
findings.studySystem: Serum fractions from IgAN patients added to cultured mesangial cells
limitations: In-vitro proliferation; activity depends on complex composition and molecular mass.

findings.subject: entity-iga-complexes
findings.text: Smaller complex fractions inhibited proliferation, qualifying a uniformly stimulatory interpretation.
findings.studySystem: Serum fractions from IgAN patients added to cultured mesangial cells
limitations: Size-dependent culture effects do not establish the net in-vivo effect of every complex.

findings.subject: entity-iga-complexes
findings.text: Patient-derived large IgA1 complexes activated ERK signalling in cultured human mesangial cells.
findings.quote: ERK activation through mesangial IgA1 receptor
findings.studySystem: Human mesangial cultures and renal-biopsy observations
limitations: The route involves CD71 and additional signalling; the diagram omits intermediate steps.

findings.subject: entity-mesangial
findings.text: IgA1-stimulated human mesangial cultures secreted IL-6; pathway blockade reduced secretion.
findings.quote: ERK activation through mesangial IgA1 receptor
findings.studySystem: Human mesangial cell cultures with signalling inhibitors
limitations: Culture perturbations; linking this branch to IgA1-producing cells is a cross-study hypothesis.

findings.subject: entity-erk
findings.text: Biopsy mesangial ERK activation was associated with higher proteinuria and elevated blood pressure.
findings.quote: ERK activation through mesangial IgA1 receptor
findings.studySystem: Human IgAN renal biopsies with clinical measurements
limitations: Biopsy association does not prove that ERK activation caused renal injury.

releaseNote: Initial bounded source-checked IgAN candidate using five primary reports. Cell-culture mechanisms and biopsy associations remain distinct. The cross-study cytokine feedback is a hypothesis; this is not comprehensive literature or therapy coverage. Independent human domain review is pending. All scores are unassessed.
